summary: Implementation plan to resolve the 3 National Census and Background Audit lifecycle issues: (1) background audit starting mid-census before citizen hydration completes, (2) the National Census getting stuck permanently at 95/98 (97%) due to server-side countryActivePopulation vs Level 10+ cohort filtering, and (3) audited citizens like N3V1T5 showing 0.0 BTC / 0 receipts despite having 2,993 cached personal receipts due to stripped auditSchemaVersion in App.tsx, swallowed AbortErrors in fetchUserTransactions, and unawaited IndexedDB cache reads in CitizenAuditModal.
